_comment: Master Mobile Plan (2026) > Recovery Measures > Recovery: Offline Reinstall and Update App > 'Recovery (offline) 4' - 'Mark Test Three released'. Run this once the device is confirmed on Test Two and before re-logging in to trigger the MEASURE_TYPE_APP_OFFLINE_REINSTALL_AND_UPDATE 'Select CCZ' screen (see offline_reinstall_update_app_flow.yaml's 'Recovery (offline) 3' step, which asserts that screen appears). saved_app_id must be the Test Three build id produced by offline_2_mark_test_two.json's create_new_build action. app_id/saved_app_id values are placeholders - refresh them each QA cycle per the sheet's reconfiguration note, do not reuse from a prior run.
